protectedFieldsNote: Article 55A.253(a) requires the petition to carry sex, race, date of birth, driver's licence number, social security number and the address at the time of arrest, and the TRN must appear on the order under art. 55A.301. All of them are blank here and are never prefilled by any pipeline stage. How the largest counties handle sensitive data in a public civil expunction filing is a recorded release blocker; the participant supplies these by hand.
outsidePartyFieldsNote: Blank and never prefilled. The matter is a new civil action and receives a NEW cause number on filing, so no cause number can exist beforehand. The court sets the hearing not earlier than the 30th day after filing and the clerk serves under art. 55A.254; the participant does not serve. No position of the attorney representing the state, no service completion and no hearing outcome is ever stated.
expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. Each ground is either a prohibited term for this track or prohibited invention. (1) Prohibited terms: the output says the record 'will be sealed' under 'the nondisclosure statute'. Nondisclosure is Gov't Code ch. 411 relief in a different code with a different venue; a Chapter 55A pleading that uses sealing or nondisclosure vocabulary is the wrong remedy on its face. (2) It asserts the consent of the attorney representing the state, and says LegalEase obtained it. The registry states in terms that LegalEase does not seek, negotiate or obtain that consent and NEVER asserts it has been given, and 'the attorney representing the state does not consent' is a recorded self-help stop condition. (3) The programme is a drug court programme. The route reaches exactly two programme types — veterans treatment court under Gov't Code ch. 124 and mental health court under ch. 125 — and any other programme is a recorded exclusion. (4) priorSpecialtyExpunction = yes on this same ground. A second expunction on the same specialty-court ground is a recorded exclusion and the affidavit attests to the opposite. (5) The court is a county court at law. Article 55A.203 is limited to DISTRICT COURTS, unlike art. 55A.201, and a court other than a district court is a recorded exclusion. (6) The window has closed: the dismissal was 06/01/2025 and the filing is 01/01/2026, far beyond the 30th day. 'The 30-day window has closed' is a recorded self-help stop condition. (7) It calls the 30 days a 'waiting period'. It is a deadline running the other way — waiting defeats the route. (8) It quotes a filing fee of $275.00 on a route where art. 55A.203(c) forbids the court charging ANY fee or assessing any cost, and art. 102.0061(d) separately requires waiver of the district-court fee. (9) It fills court identity no source supplies: cause number, judicial district and judge name. (10) It asserts service completion by the petitioner, a hearing date and a hearing outcome — none of which exists on a streamlined order route, and all of which are outside-party or court acts. (11) It populates every art. 55A.253(a) protected identifier and the TRN, all of which must stay blank. (12) It states an eligibilityBasisLabel asserting confirmed eligibility resting on the State's consent, when no eligibility conclusion may be asserted and consent may never be asserted at all.
